lead.headline: Bitmine Now Holds 5% of All ETH as Corporate Treasury Strategy Reaches Unprecedented Scale
lead.tldr: Bitmine's $4 billion buyback and 5.78 million ETH treasury—nearly 5% of circulating supply—marks the first time a single corporate vehicle has captured this concentration of a major L1 asset, while regulatory scaffolding in the US, Nigeria, and Abu Dhabi simultaneously hardens around crypto.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, the throughline today is concentration risk dressed up as conviction: one firm now controls a network stake that would trigger governance alarm bells in any traditional asset class, even as regulators across three continents race to build guardrails for exactly this kind of exposure.

top_signals.title: Trump agrees to ethics provision as crypto bill inches closer to Senate vote
top_signals.summary: President Trump has agreed to include ethics provisions in a pending crypto bill, removing a potential hurdle for its passage. This agreement brings the legislation closer to a Senate vote and potential enactment into law.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The ethics provision compromise signals that crypto legislation is now subject to standard Congressional horse-trading rather than categorical opposition, which means the probability of enactment should be repriced upward by any LP still treating US regulatory risk as binary.

top_signals.title: Bitmine expands Ethereum treasury to 5.78 million ETH, repurchases 5.5 million shares
top_signals.summary: Bitmine has significantly increased its Ethereum holdings to 5.78 million ETH. Additionally, the company repurchased 5.5 million shares as part of a larger $4 billion buyback initiative.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A $4 billion buyback concurrent with ETH accumulation suggests Bitmine's management views its own equity as undervalued relative to the asset it holds, an arbitrage thesis that only holds if the market continues to misprice the treasury strategy itself.

top_signals.title: Tether Gold recognized as Accepted Spot Commodity in Abu Dhabi financial center 5m
top_signals.summary: Tether Gold (XAUt) has been officially recognized as an accepted spot commodity within the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM). This regulatory milestone provides institutional legitimacy for gold-backed tokens in a major financial hub.
top_signals.why_it_matters: ADGM's acceptance of XAUt as a spot commodity creates a template for other tokenized real assets to gain institutional clearing status, which matters for any founder building in the RWA infrastructure layer.

top_signals.title: Bitmine grows treasury to 5.78M ETH as Ether outpaces Bitcoin20m, Bitmine grows treasury to 5.78M ETH as Ether outpaces BitcoinThe Ethereum treasury firm added 7,430 ETH over the past week, bringing its holdings to nearly 5% of the network’s circulating supply.
top_signals.summary: Bitmine has increased its Ethereum treasury to 5.78 million ETH, adding 7,430 ETH in the last week. The firm now holds approximately 5% of the total circulating supply of ETH.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Crossing the 5% threshold turns Bitmine from a large holder into a systemic concentration for Ethereum, meaning its treasury management decisions now carry network-level externalities that no traditional equity analyst is trained to underwrite.

top_signals.title: Nigerian president signs order on approach to crypto regulation, taxes25m, Nigerian president signs order on approach to crypto regulation, taxesThe West African country’s executive order established a virtual asset council and addressed the fragmentation of crypto regulation for oversight and enforcement.
top_signals.summary: The Nigerian president has signed an executive order to streamline the regulation and taxation of virtual assets. The order establishes a virtual asset council to reduce regulatory fragmentation and improve oversight and enforcement.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nigeria's executive order is the first serious attempt by a major African economy to consolidate crypto oversight under a single council rather than fragmented agencies, which could accelerate institutional capital deployment if enforcement proves consistent.

deals.summary: MicroStrategy has increased its cash reserves to $3.225 billion by selling MSTR shares, raising $263.5 million. The company continues its aggressive Bitcoin accumulation strategy, now holding 843,775 BTC.

on_the_radar.title: Hut 8 fully commercializes 1 GW Texas AI campus with second $9.8B lease as IREN signs $2.8B in contracts; shares climb double digits
on_the_radar.summary: Hut 8 and IREN are accelerating their pivot from Bitcoin mining to AI infrastructure, securing massive lease and contract deals. Hut 8 has fully commercialized its 1 GW Texas campus with a $9.8B lease, while IREN signed $2.8B in contracts.

on_the_radar.title: 3 charts on the tokenized stocks boom
on_the_radar.summary: Tokenized stocks have experienced significant growth, with their market capitalization increasing fivefold to $1.7 billion. This surge is driven by accelerated issuance, higher transfer volumes, and increasing adoption by Wall Street institutions.

on_the_radar.title: Russia’s parliament to hold final readings on crypto bill Tuesday10m, Russia’s parliament to hold final readings on crypto bill TuesdayRussia’s State Duma is set to consider the crypto regulation bill in second and third readings, with rules for investors and cross-border payments included.
on_the_radar.summary: Russia's State Duma is preparing for the final readings of a comprehensive crypto regulation bill. The legislation aims to establish clear rules for investors and the use of digital assets for cross-border payments.

on_the_radar.title: Grayscale plans regular cash payouts from ETH, SOL staking rewards 33m, Grayscale plans regular cash payouts from ETH, SOL staking rewards Grayscale plans to establish regular cash distributions from staking rewards generated by its Ether and Solana exchange-traded products.
on_the_radar.summary: Grayscale intends to implement regular cash distributions for investors based on staking rewards from its Ether and Solana exchange-traded products. This move aims to provide a yield-bearing mechanism for institutional and retail holders of these digital asset products.

on_the_radar.title: Democrats Added Certain Consumer Protection Rules to CLARITY: Coinbase Exec
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase executive Ryan VanGrack reports that Democrats have integrated stronger consumer protection measures into the CLARITY Act. The bill is currently under consideration in the Senate.

on_the_radar.title: Hyperliquid Unveils Plan for Permissionless Prediction Markets
on_the_radar.summary: Hyperliquid has announced a plan to implement permissionless prediction markets via HIP-4. The system will include safeguards such as a six-month stake lock and slashing mechanisms to ensure market integrity and proper settlement.

on_the_radar.title: Vietnam sets fines for unlicensed crypto trading ahead of regulation rollout11m, Vietnam sets fines for unlicensed crypto trading ahead of regulation rolloutThe new rules establish penalties as much as $1,9000 for crypto violations, including unlicensed trading and AML breaches, ahead of Vietnam’s regulated crypto market launch.
on_the_radar.summary: Vietnam has introduced fines of up to $1,900 for unlicensed cryptocurrency trading and anti-money laundering (AML) breaches. These measures serve as a precursor to the official rollout of a regulated cryptocurrency market framework in the country.

on_the_radar.title: Zilliqa Investigates ZIL Theft After Suspected Exchange Wallet Breach
on_the_radar.summary: Zilliqa is investigating the theft of ZIL tokens following a suspected breach of an exchange partner's cold wallet. The project has requested that trading platforms temporarily suspend ZIL deposits and withdrawals to mitigate further risk.

linkedin_post: We have never seen a single corporate entity hold 5% of a major network's circulating supply. Bitmine now sits on 5.78 million ETH, added 7,430 more this week, and is running a $4 billion share buyback alongside it. The buyback is the tell: management thinks the market is underpricing the treasury, not overpaying for it. That only works if the ETH position itself is not the risk the equity is pricing in. We are not sure that trade is clean. The 5% number matters because it crosses into territory where Bitmine's liquidity decisions, collateral choices, or forced sales become Ethereum network events. No traditional equity framework captures this. The sell-side still models this as a levered crypto proxy. It is not. It is a new asset class with its own correlation structure, and the tools to underwrite it do not exist yet. The test is simple: if Bitmine ever needs to reduce that position by even 10% in a stressed market, how does the network absorb it? We do not know. That is the position we are underwriting, not the ETH price. Elsewhere, the US crypto bill clears its ethics hurdle, Nigeria centralizes its oversight, and ADGM puts Tether Gold on its commodity board. The pattern is regulatory scaffolding catching up to concentrated exposure. The scaffolding is welcome. The concentration is what we are watching.
